_tour.texte: Image 1 is a pose guide: a generic stick figure. Copy ONLY its pose from it — the angle of each limb, which foot is forward, which foot is on the ground. Ignore its body: its height, its build, the length of its limbs and the size of its head are NOT the character's. Image 2 is the character: keep its own body proportions, silhouette, colours, outfit and drawing style exactly as they are. Draw the character of Image 2 standing in the pose of Image 1. Single isolated sprite, plain background.
_tour.attendu: Michel dans la pose du guide d'adulte, mais avec SES proportions a lui : jambes courtes, grande capuche, manteau long. Le guide ne donne plus que les angles et le pied au sol ; le corps vient de l'image du personnage. Meme guide qu'au tour 1 : seul le texte change.
_tour.peut_rater: Le modele peut continuer a copier la carrure du guide malgre l'interdiction ; ou, a force de lui dire d'ignorer le corps du guide, relacher la pose et retomber en idle ; ou dessiner le bonhomme baton lui-meme.
